notes: Fixed a crash: when the MagicBoard opened a device login page, the credential pop-up could appear over Wingman's own window and close the app. Wingman now leaves its own windows alone — the MagicBoard logs you in by itself.

MagicBoard auto-login now waits for the login form to finish rendering (Catalyst Center and other single-page apps draw it a moment after the page loads), so it reliably fills and submits your saved credential.
